_note: Single source of truth for what each dataset in this build really is. The dashboard reads this file to label data. When the real NASA PSI tables replace a placeholder, change its status to "nasa_measured" and fill in the source fields. Text convention (same as config/simulation_model.json): the plain key is English and the matching *_zh key is the Chinese version shown when the dashboard language is 中文.

BASS_II.display_name: BASS-II (Burning and Suppression of Solids II)
BASS_II.display_name_zh: BASS-II（固体燃烧与抑制实验 II）
BASS_II.imitates: NASA PSI-25 BASS-II experimental table format
known_issues: Rows are produced by formulas (regular steps in fan setting, O2, frames, GMT), not copied from the NASA table.
The real PSI-25 experimental table has about 130 records; it has not been downloaded into this repository.
known_issues_zh: 数据行由公式生成（风扇设定、O2、帧数、GMT 均呈规律递增），并非从 NASA 数据表复制。
真实的 PSI-25 实验数据表约有 130 条记录，尚未下载到本仓库。

FLEX.imitates: NASA PSI-69 FLEX experimental table format
known_issues: Rows are produced by formulas (arithmetic steps in pressure, diameter, burning rate, burn time), not copied from the NASA table.
known_issues_zh: 数据行由公式生成（压力、直径、燃烧速率、燃烧时间均为等差递增），并非从 NASA 数据表复制。

MACFP_PMMA_CONE.display_name_zh: MaCFP PMMA 锥形量热仪（地面试验）
known_issues: Ground-based (1 g) tests; not microgravity or spacecraft data.
known_issues_zh: 地面（1 g）试验数据，并非微重力或航天器数据。

known_issues: Built from the synthetic BASS-II and FLEX placeholder tables above.
BASS-II burn-rate target is computed as fan_setting x 0.0016 x 1.5, and the same fan setting also drives an input feature (Reynolds number): label leakage.
BASS-II 'extinguished' label is a rule (final CO <= 2 ppm), not an observed extinction.
The 5 x 5 repeated folds are correlated re-splits of the same 80 rows, not 25 independent experiments.
known_issues_zh: 由上述合成的 BASS-II 与 FLEX 占位数据表构建。
BASS-II 的燃烧速率目标值按 风扇设定 x 0.0016 x 1.5 计算，而同一风扇设定也决定了输入特征（雷诺数）：存在标签泄漏。
BASS-II 的“熄灭”标签是一条规则（最终 CO <= 2 ppm），并非观测到的熄灭。
5 x 5 重复折是对同样 80 行数据的相关性重复划分，并非 25 次独立实验。
